procedure.stepLabel: Make Connections and make sure to Witness Mark
procedure.stepDescription: Make Connections and make sure to Witness Mark

steps.label: Secure the Fuse box to the beam, hand start 2 screws
Install Gateway Module to IP to the 2 slotted openings on Driver Side...
Install 1 Gray rosebud to Gateway bracket and 1 Gray rosebud to beam
Make Connections and make sure to Witness Mark
Check connections on HVAC and Radio
Torque down (2) Screws to the Gateway Module
Torque down (2) Screws to Fuse Box Module
Rotate IP to Car Position - Make (2) Rosebuds to Duct and Beam
OPTION: Obtain and Scan Ambient Air Quality Sensor. Torque with 1 screw.
OPTION: Make 1 wire connection and seat 1 rosebud to Ambient Air...
Obtain and Install VCS Center Bracket with (2) fasteners
Obtain and Install VCS Driver Side Bracket with (3) fasteners
OPTION [NO HUD]: Install (1) additional fastener to VCS Driver Side...
Secure Rosebud Connections: (2) Rosebuds to Center Vent (1) Rosebud to...
